0.description: Function name as serialised upstream. Values are resolved to concepts of ogc.hosted.seadots.fcm-activation-scheme by context.jsonld. Note that the upstream label "gaussian" resolves to fcmact:logistic-of-square, which is what the implementation computes; see that block's description.

Numeric parameters keyed by name. Which names are meaningful depends on `label` and is declared by fcmact:hasParameterName on the corresponding concept (`a`, `b`, `lambda` for the implemented functions).

properties.description: Graph-local key of the concept, unique within the map, e.g. "C1" or "Nd". Referenced by the `src` and `dst` fields of edges. Not an IRI; the concept IRI, when known, belongs in the catalog record or in a future `concept` field (see description.md).

Human-readable name of the concept, conventionally prefixed with the node key in square brackets, e.g. "[C2] Stress Level". Despite the field name this is a label rather than a description, and is mapped to skos:prefLabel.
Optional graph-local key of the edge, conventionally "SRC->DST".
Key of the driving concept. Must equal the `id` of a vertex of the same map.
Key of the influenced concept. Must equal the `id` of a vertex of the same map.
Signed strength of the influence. Conventionally dimensionless in [-1, 1]; the convention is documented but NOT enforced upstream, and is not enforced here either. See description.md.
Free-text statement of the causal claim the edge encodes.
Free-text statement of where the weight came from. Marked as temporary upstream; expected to become a structured reference to the elicitation record (see description.md).
Node keys, in the order used by both axes of `weights`.
Optional map from node key to human-readable label.

Declares that weights[i][j] is the influence of nodes[i] ON nodes[j]. Stated as a required constant rather than assumed, because the opposite convention is equally common and silently transposes the entire model. The solver applies the transpose at iteration time, computing f(W' x).
Square matrix of signed weights; absent influences are 0.
